title: Region demand funnel and automated classification engine for enterprise residency requests
creator: Arielle Chen
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers submit region availability and data residency requests through a mix of sales tickets, email, and legal intake forms. Triage is manual, slow, and inconsistent across regions and account tiers. Impact: delayed onboarding for large customers, missed SLAs for enterprise contracts, and ad hoc handoffs between Product, Sales, and Infra.

Goal: Build a 'region demand funnel' that centralizes incoming residency requests, applies an automated classification/score (risk, revenue, latency need, regulatory requirement), and surfaces assignment suggestions and SLA-driven routing to Sales SEs, Hosting Ops, and Legal. This ticket scopes the PM work to define the scoring model, API contract, priority buckets, and success criteria; implementation tickets will split into backend intake webhook, scoring API, and Console route UI.

Out of scope: Full region provisioning automation, procurement of cloud regions, and physical provisioning playbooks. Those are downstream tasks owned by Infra and Cloud Ops.
acceptance_criteria: A centralized intake endpoint (webhook) spec is approved by Legal and Sales Ops and documented in Confluence
A classification model with >= 4 weighted signals (revenue cohort, regulatory flag, required failover latency, existing entitlements) is defined and validated against 60 historical requests
Routing matrix maps classification buckets to destination queues (Sales SE, Solutions Eng, Infra Provisioning, Legal) with SLA targets defined
Console mock shows a single-pane request overview and suggested next-step actions; UX validated with two enterprise SEs
Success metric baseline documented: time-to-first-assignment and percent of requests auto-classified with confidence >= 0.7
decision_log: 2026-01-27: Decided to prioritize automated classification over full automation to reduce operational risk and enable faster iteration
2026-01-29: Weighting will favor regulatory constraints and contract entitlements for P0 routing to Legal; revenue tier will be used for expedited processing for Sales-assisted customers
2026-02-02: Agreed not to store customer PII in classification payload; only tokenized identifiers and policy flags will be persisted
2026-02-04: Chose a lightweight JSON schema for intake payload to ease integration with existing Sales CRMs and Zendesk
implementation_steps: Draft intake webhook JSON schema and share with Sales Ops and Legal
Run a backfill analysis of 60 recent residency/region requests to extract useful signals and label outcomes
Define scoring rubric and weights; produce a small rule-based prototype for initial release
Build scoring API contract and a stub service; expose a dry-run mode that returns scores without routing
Create Console UI wireframes for request detail and suggested actions; collect 2 enterprise SE feedback cycles
Instrument metrics: time-to-assignment, percent auto-classified, and false-route rate
Prepare rollout plan with training docs for Sales and Support and a sales-handback checklist
